description_en: Resets the logon password of a specified user. Specify the user by agentCoreUserId or username. At least one of the two parameters must be specified. Only users who use workspace local password authentication can be reset. If password is not specified, the server generates a random password and returns it in the response
description_zh: 重置指定用户的登录密码。通过 agentCoreUserId 或 username 指定用户，两者至少指定一个。仅支持重置使用工作空间本地密码认证的用户；不指定 password 时由服务端生成随机密码并在响应中返回
name: ResetUserPassword

fields.help_en: The user ID. At least one of agentCoreUserId and username must be specified. If both are specified, agentCoreUserId takes precedence
fields.help_zh: 用户 ID。与 username 至少指定一个，同时指定时以 agentCoreUserId 为准
fields.name: agent_core_user_id

fields.help_en: The new password after the reset. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password cannot contain the username. If this parameter is not specified, the server generates a random password
fields.help_zh: 重置后的密码，长度为 8~32 个字符，必须同时包含大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符，并且不能包含用户名称。不指定该参数时由服务端生成随机密码
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The username. At least one of username and agentCoreUserId must be specified
fields.help_zh: 用户名称。与 agentCoreUserId 至少指定一个
fields.name: username

parameters.help_en: The request body for resetting the user password
parameters.help_zh: 重置用户密码的请求内容
parameters.name: body

password.description_en: The password that takes effect after the reset. If password was specified, the specified password is returned. If password was not specified, the random password generated by the server is returned
password.description_zh: 重置后生效的密码。指定了 password 则返回该密码，未指定时返回服务端生成的随机密码

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
